value.rationale: All-length finite composition, cyclic homopolymer cap and reverse-complement-fixed symmetry classification is a natural DNA codebook counting invariant. Sharp parity obstruction (especially four-divisibility for balanced words), exact primitive counts and explicit growth asymptotic distinguish physical strand symmetries and quantify their prevalence. It completes a meaningful structural class beyond linear run-word enumeration, not just a small integer table or weak normalization check.
